label: FOUND
role: FP8 index-key scoring over ~100K history per request on 21 full-indexer layers; 12.8 us/call in graph (b101).
pcvs: padded tokens L, splits S, pages, heads 1..32, dim 8..128, CTAs, in-bounds query rows
finding: Exact: 132 B K+scale reads per padded token, 4 B logits writes; tensor_float_flops = 32768*L, i.e. 4x the useful work, because BLOCK_Q = 128/heads = 4 at H32 while decode has one query per request. Critical-lane chain (latency model with tensor pipe, source lines via -lineinfo): the page loop is an MMA <-> epilogue ping-pong - the epilogue waits at sm100_mqa_logits.cuh:423 on the MMA issued at :334 [tensor pipe], the MMA warp waits for the epilogue to free the accumulator; with BLOCK_Q=1 the MMA wait vanishes (path -14% at 2 pages/request, per-page cost 375 -> 219 units). Every warp role also starts with three dependent scheduler loads (sm100_paged_mqa_logits.cuh:46 ceil_div on context_lens).
fix: BLOCK_Q=1 instantiation of the existing core (dg_bq1.cu): 8192 tensor FLOPs per token (exactly 4x less), identical KV/logit bytes; 40/40 drperf reference states pass.
fix_status: Standalone GPU win when L2-resident; harness A/B pending.
timing: B300 standalone b112 (bitwise, 400222 logits): batch 4 hot 12.48 -> 10.78 us (1.16x), cold HBM 17.06 -> 16.86 us (1.01x); batch 1 hot 10.14 -> 8.58 us. In-graph the upstream kernel runs 12.8 us (b101), close to the hot figure.
credit: DrPerf found the 4x tensor work, the ping-pong chain and checked the prototype; GPU confirmed the L2-resident gain.
